expected_citations.claim: Peak tensor compute throughput increased from 450 TFLOPS to 620 TFLOPS FP16.

sources.snippet: Peak tensor compute throughput is rated at 450 TFLOPS FP16 at a base operating frequency of 1.85 GHz.
Peak tensor compute throughput has been increased to 620 TFLOPS FP16, operating at an overclocked frequency of 2.20 GHz
Maximum thermal design power (TDP) is 220 Watts.
Maximum thermal design power (TDP) was re-rated to 285 Watts (increased from 220 Watts due to elevated clock profiles).
